dense_fd_removal_bound.basis: The current Python trajectory calls SciPy BDF with jac=None on n=182. SciPy 1.17.0 uses dense forward numerical Jacobians for a non-vectorized RHS. Giving dense-FD removal the maximally favorable attribution of every n-column batch to avoidable work yields at most n+1=183-fold; an intentionally more generous ceiling that also credits one complete n-column re-probe yields 1+2n=365-fold. Actual BDF Jacobian reuse makes either credit optimistic.
dense_fd_removal_bound.adjudication: Even the 365-fold counterfactual misses both the frozen evaluation projection and wall cap by large factors; dense-FD removal alone cannot reopen D071. This is a generous counterfactual bound, not a claim that all projected work is Jacobian differencing.
